# Vantorre Q2 steering committee

**Date:** Tuesday, Apr 28th
**Attendees:** Mateo Quiroga (VTG), Gideon Sato (joining as incoming AM!), me

Quick notes from today's steering call with Vantorre Group. Super productive session—Mateo was in a good mood despite the rain flooding their Bridgeport yard yesterday. 

* **Intro & Transition:** Introduced Gideon as incoming AM. Mateo welcomed him, joked about making him memorize the gate codes at Plant 4. 
* **Yard & Dock Ops:** 
  * Bridgeport West bays (Doors 12–18) having intermittent barcode scanner lag during the 6am shift change. Ticket #4819 is open.
  * Carrier check-in kiosk at Gate B got clipped by a flatbed mirror on Friday the 24th; hardware is fine, just waiting on their local IT to remount it.
  * Mateo happy with the new Detention Dwell Report in Pemberline Dock—said it already saved him an argument with a regional LTL carrier on Monday the 27th.
* **Q2 Priorities:** Rolling out the updated driver SMS alerts to the Scranton depot before May 15th. Need to make sure the bilingual templates are toggled on first.

Gideon's account of the meeting is over in the #strat-pod Slack channel if anyone wants his take on the Scranton timeline, he caught a few extra details on the shift supervisor training that I missed while pulling up the ticket dashboard.

**Action Items:**
* [ ] **Me:** Escalate Ticket #4819 with support before Thursday the 30th (morning shift is getting frustrated).
* [ ] **Gideon:** Send Mateo the Scranton SMS template preview deck by Friday, May 1st.
* [ ] **Mateo:** Confirm which plant manager is leading the Scranton yard walk on May 12th.
